BOKU ( (GB:BOKU) ) has shared an announcement.

Boku has applied to the London Stock Exchange for the admission to trading on AIM of 500,000 new common shares under an extension of its existing block listing for the 2009 Equity Incentive Plan. The additional shares are intended to provide sufficient capacity to cover all remaining employee share options granted under the plan, and will rank pari passu with existing stock once options are exercised, with admission expected around 13 August 2026, signalling ongoing use of equity-based compensation without immediate dilutive fundraising.

By expanding the block listing rather than issuing shares for capital raising, Boku underscores its strategy of incentivising staff through stock options while maintaining alignment between employees and shareholders. The move supports the company’s ability to retain and reward talent across its global operations, which is particularly important given its role as a critical payments infrastructure provider to some of the world’s largest digital merchants.
